levels.rank.1.name: Hobbit of the Shire
levels.rank.1.about: Six meals a day leave a hobbit little time for long walks.
levels.rank.2.name: Pac-Man
levels.rank.2.about: On every level of the 1980 arcade game, he goes round the same maze.
levels.rank.3.name: Ori
levels.rank.3.about: The storm blew him off the Spirit Tree like a leaf.
levels.rank.4.name: The Nameless Hero
levels.rank.4.about: His whole world fitted under the Barrier, about 2 km across.
levels.rank.5.name: Baron Harkonnen
levels.rank.5.about: Suspensors and ornithopters carry him around Arrakis, so he seldom walks on his own two feet.
levels.rank.6.name: Chell
levels.rank.6.about: She completed every test chamber at Aperture Science, then escaped through the facility’s maintenance areas.
levels.rank.7.name: V of Night City
levels.rank.7.about: V gets around Night City, from Watson to Santo Domingo, mostly by car.
levels.rank.9.name: Gordon Freeman
levels.rank.9.about: Crowbar in hand, he fought his way through Black Mesa, from the site of the accident to the portal to Xen.
levels.rank.10.name: The Chosen Undead
levels.rank.10.about: To ring both bells, he went from the church at the top of Lordran all the way down to the swamp at the bottom.
levels.rank.12.name: The Marked One
levels.rank.12.about: From the Cordon he crossed the whole Zone to the Power Plant.
levels.rank.13.name: The Hero of Kvatch
levels.rank.13.about: He started in a cell under the Imperial City and closed his first Oblivion Gate at Kvatch.
levels.rank.15.name: Kyle Crane
levels.rank.15.about: He got around Harran mostly over the rooftops, because the streets were full of the infected.
levels.rank.17.name: Dragonborn
levels.rank.17.about: He could fast travel, but some cave always turns up along the way.
levels.rank.19.name: Link
levels.rank.19.about: Looking for 120 shrines, he crossed Hyrule from the Great Plateau to the farthest mountains.
levels.rank.21.name: Minsc and Boo
levels.rank.21.about: Together they crossed the Sword Coast in the first Baldur’s Gate and Amn in the second.
levels.rank.23.name: Master Chief
levels.rank.23.about: From the lifeboat to the Library, he covered a good stretch of the Halo ring.
levels.rank.26.name: The Lone Wanderer
levels.rank.26.about: He took his first steps outside Vault 101, blinded by a sun he had never seen before.
levels.rank.31.name: Arthur Morgan
levels.rank.31.about: He sketched the gang’s journey from snowbound Colter to Saint Denis in his journal.
levels.rank.35.name: The Courier of the Mojave
levels.rank.35.about: After being shot in the head, he crossed the desert from Goodsprings to Hoover Dam.
levels.rank.40.name: Rincewind
levels.rank.40.about: With Twoflower and the Luggage, he fled Ankh-Morpork all the way to the Rim of the Disc.
levels.rank.44.name: Mario
levels.rank.44.about: In the first Super Mario Bros., he went through 32 levels, from 1-1 to 8-4, to rescue the princess.
levels.rank.48.name: Ash Ketchum
levels.rank.48.about: With Pikachu, he travelled from region to region until he became the Alola League Champion.
levels.rank.52.name: Lara Croft
levels.rank.52.about: She searched for tombs on every continent, usually on foot and with a rope.
levels.rank.55.name: Nathan Drake
levels.rank.55.about: He hunted for treasure from Borneo to Madagascar.
levels.rank.59.name: Kratos
levels.rank.59.about: With his son, he carried his wife’s ashes across Midgard to the highest peak in all the realms.
levels.rank.62.name: Geralt of Rivia
levels.rank.62.about: He is not actually from Rivia, but he knows the roads of the Continent from Kaer Morhen to Toussaint.
levels.rank.65.name: Aloy
levels.rank.65.about: She crossed the whole Forbidden West on foot, from the deserts to the ruins by the ocean.
levels.rank.69.name: Ellie
levels.rank.69.about: From Boston, she walked west across the ruined United States.
levels.rank.72.name: Arya Stark
levels.rank.72.about: From King’s Landing, she crossed the whole of the Riverlands, then reached Braavos and came back.
levels.rank.75.name: Arthas
levels.rank.75.about: He went all the way to the glaciers of Northrend for a cursed sword.
levels.rank.78.name: Paul Atreides
levels.rank.78.about: He fled Arrakeen into the deep desert, then crossed all of Arrakis with the Fremen.
levels.rank.81.name: Ciri
levels.rank.81.about: Fleeing the Wild Hunt, she kept landing in worlds with no easy way back.
levels.rank.84.name: Duncan Idaho
levels.rank.84.about: The Swordmaster of House Atreides spent long months in the desert with the Fremen.
levels.rank.87.name: Bilbo Baggins
levels.rank.87.about: With thirteen dwarves, he went from Bag End to the Lonely Mountain, there and back again.
levels.rank.89.name: Frodo Baggins
levels.rank.89.about: It took him half a year to walk from the Shire to Mount Doom.
levels.rank.92.name: Sam Porter Bridges
levels.rank.92.about: He connected America on foot, coast to coast.
levels.rank.95.name: Odysseus
levels.rank.95.about: It took him ten years to get home to Ithaca.
levels.rank.97.name: Roland Deschain
levels.rank.97.about: He followed the man in black across the desert, then crossed Mid-World to the Dark Tower.
levels.rank.100.name: The Grey Pilgrim
levels.rank.100.about: He wandered Middle-earth for two thousand years.
levels.achievement.km1.name: Tutorial Complete
levels.achievement.km1.flavor: The character walked the first kilometre and the tutorial disappeared from the screen.
levels.achievement.km2.name: Beyond the Barrier
levels.achievement.km2.flavor: According to the game’s description, the magic barrier over the Colony in Gothic is a sphere two kilometres across. This is from wall to wall.
levels.achievement.km57.name: Skyrim on Foot
levels.achievement.km57.flavor: That is roughly how wide the in-game map of Skyrim is from west to east. A whole province, at the game’s scale, crossed on foot.
levels.achievement.km113.name: Diagonally Across Erangel
levels.achievement.km113.flavor: The Erangel map in PUBG is 8 by 8 km, so corner to corner is over 11 km.
levels.achievement.km212.name: Chernarus, Corner to Corner
levels.achievement.km212.flavor: Chernarus in DayZ covers 225 km², or 15 by 15 km. Corner to corner, that comes to over 21 km.
levels.achievement.km24.name: Nether Shortcut
levels.achievement.km24.flavor: In Minecraft’s Nether every block counts as eight. There, these 24 km are only 3,000 blocks.
levels.achievement.km30.name: Through the Zone
levels.achievement.km30.flavor: The Zone in S.T.A.L.K.E.R. is an area around a power plant with a radius of about 30 km. From the Cordon in the south to the Power Plant itself.
levels.achievement.km447.name: The Citadel, End to End
levels.achievement.km447.flavor: The Citadel station in Mass Effect is 44.7 km long, end to end.
levels.achievement.km53.name: Chilkoot Pass
levels.achievement.km53.flavor: Buck from London’s “The Call of the Wild” takes the trail over Chilkoot Pass towards the Klondike. From Dyea to Lake Bennett it is 53 km.
levels.achievement.km63.name: The Edge of Valheim
levels.achievement.km63.flavor: The world of Valheim is a disc with a radius of 10 km. All the way round, along the very edge, it comes to almost 63 km.
levels.achievement.km70.name: Tsushima, North to South
levels.achievement.km70.flavor: Tsushima Island, where Ghost of Tsushima is set, is about 70 km from north to south in real life.
levels.achievement.km805.name: By Elephant to Allahabad
levels.achievement.km805.flavor: In “Around the World in Eighty Days”, 50 miles of railway are missing between Kholby and Allahabad. Phileas Fogg crosses that gap on the back of an elephant.
levels.achievement.km100.name: Silver Jogger
levels.achievement.km100.flavor: The silver Jogger medal in Pokémon GO takes 100 km walked with a phone in your pocket.
levels.achievement.km115.name: Bucklebury Ferry
levels.achievement.km115.flavor: On Frodo’s road: the ferry across the Brandywine on the eastern edge of the Shire.
levels.achievement.km160.name: Straight Through the Death Star
levels.achievement.km160.flavor: The first Death Star was 160 km across. That is the distance from pole to pole.
levels.achievement.km200.name: Carthag to Arrakeen
levels.achievement.km200.flavor: That is the distance between two cities of Arrakis in “Dune”. The Fremen would walk it without rhythm so as not to attract a worm.
levels.achievement.km215.name: The Prancing Pony
levels.achievement.km215.flavor: On Frodo’s road: the inn at Bree, beyond the borders of the Shire.
levels.achievement.km246.name: Athens to Sparta
levels.achievement.km246.flavor: According to Herodotus’ “Histories”, the messenger Pheidippides ran from Athens to Sparta in two days. The Spartathlon on this route is 246 km.
levels.achievement.km318.name: Across the Halo
levels.achievement.km318.flavor: The Halo ring is 318 km wide. This is from one wall to the other.
levels.achievement.km385.name: Weathertop
levels.achievement.km385.flavor: On Frodo’s road: a ruined watchtower on a lonely hill by the Great East Road.
levels.achievement.km420.name: Togo’s Longest Leg
levels.achievement.km420.flavor: In the 1925 serum run to Nome, the team led by the dog Togo covered 261 miles, about 420 km. It was the longest leg of the whole relay.
levels.achievement.km483.name: Patrolling the Wall
levels.achievement.km483.flavor: The Wall closes off the north of Westeros from sea to sea. You have patrolled its whole length.
levels.achievement.km583.name: The Appian Way to Brindisi
levels.achievement.km583.flavor: Sienkiewicz set the “Quo vadis, Domine?” scene on the Appian Way. According to Britannica, the road ran 132 miles to Capua and 230 more beyond, about 583 km in all.
levels.achievement.km640.name: St. Olav’s Way
levels.achievement.km640.flavor: The pilgrim route from Oslo to Nidaros Cathedral in Trondheim, where King Olaf was buried, is about 640 km.
levels.achievement.km737.name: To Rivendell
levels.achievement.km737.flavor: That is how far the hobbits walked from Hobbiton to the House of Elrond, with the Nazgûl on their heels.
levels.achievement.km800.name: Fetching Pathfinder
levels.achievement.km800.flavor: Watney from “The Martian” drives a rover to fetch the old Pathfinder probe. According to NASA, the Ares 3 landing site lies about 800 km north of it.
levels.achievement.km950.name: Boston to Pittsburgh
levels.achievement.km950.flavor: Joel and Ellie’s first big stretch in The Last of Us, along overgrown highways.
levels.achievement.km1009.name: The Unlikely Pilgrimage of Harold Fry
levels.achievement.km1009.flavor: In Rachel Joyce’s novel, retired Harold Fry goes out to post a letter and keeps on walking, from Kingsbridge to Berwick-upon-Tweed. That is 627 miles, about 1,009 km.
levels.achievement.km1085.name: Serum for Nome
levels.achievement.km1085.flavor: In 1925 a relay of dog sled teams carried serum from Nenana to Nome: 674 miles, about 1,085 km, in five and a half days. Balto led the last leg.
levels.achievement.km1190.name: The Pass of Caradhras
levels.achievement.km1190.flavor: On the Fellowship’s road: the snowy pass that would not let them through the mountains.
levels.achievement.km1257.name: Around the Mun
levels.achievement.km1257.flavor: The Mun in Kerbal Space Program has a radius of 200 km. You have gone round it without a rocket.
levels.achievement.km1285.name: The Doors of Durin
levels.achievement.km1285.flavor: From Rivendell to the western wall of Moria, through the snows of Caradhras.
levels.achievement.km1407.name: Land’s End to John o’ Groats
levels.achievement.km1407.flavor: The classic walk across the whole of Great Britain, from a headland in Cornwall to the northern tip of Scotland. By road it is traditionally 874 miles, or 1,407 km.
levels.achievement.km1480.name: Lothlórien
levels.achievement.km1480.flavor: On the Fellowship’s road: the golden wood of the Elves by the Silverlode, where winter never seems to come.
levels.achievement.km1609.name: The Ringworld’s Rim Wall
levels.achievement.km1609.flavor: The walls along the edges of the Ringworld in Niven’s novel are about 1,000 miles high. That is the distance straight up, if you could walk them.
levels.achievement.km1697.name: Tōkai Nature Trail
levels.achievement.km1697.flavor: Japan’s Tōkai Nature Trail runs through the mountains from Takao near Tokyo to Minoh near Osaka. According to the Tokyo government, it is 1,697 km long.
levels.achievement.km1770.name: Wild
levels.achievement.km1770.flavor: In “Wild”, Cheryl Strayed describes how she walked 1,100 miles of the Pacific Crest Trail alone. That is about 1,770 km.
levels.achievement.km1854.name: Daymar’s Equator
levels.achievement.km1854.flavor: Daymar, a moon of the gas giant Crusader in Star Citizen, has a radius of 295 km in the game. Its equator is about 1,854 km.
levels.achievement.km1935.name: The Rapids of Sarn Gebir
levels.achievement.km1935.flavor: On the Fellowship’s road: rocky rapids on the Anduin, where the boats have to be carried along the bank.
levels.achievement.km2000.name: Via Francigena
levels.achievement.km2000.flavor: Archbishop Sigeric described the pilgrim route from Canterbury to Rome in 990. According to guidebooks, today’s route is about 2,000 km.
levels.achievement.km2105.name: The Falls of Rauros
levels.achievement.km2105.flavor: The great falls on the Anduin, which the Fellowship reached in elven boats.
levels.achievement.km2220.name: Down from the Emyn Muil
levels.achievement.km2220.flavor: On Frodo and Sam’s road: after a few days lost among the rocks, the climb down the cliff on an elven rope.
levels.achievement.km2300.name: The Great Barrier Reef
levels.achievement.km2300.flavor: The reef where Nemo lives in the Pixar film stretches along the coast of Australia for over 2,300 km.
levels.achievement.km2360.name: The Dead Marshes
levels.achievement.km2360.flavor: On Frodo and Sam’s road: marshes full of lights you must not follow.
levels.achievement.km2414.name: Along the Rabbit-Proof Fence
levels.achievement.km2414.flavor: In the film “Rabbit-Proof Fence”, three girls run away from a settlement and walk home along the fence for nine weeks. That is 1,500 miles, about 2,414 km.
levels.achievement.km2480.name: The Black Gate
levels.achievement.km2480.flavor: On Frodo and Sam’s road: the closed gate of Mordor.
levels.achievement.km2540.name: Ithilien
levels.achievement.km2540.flavor: On Frodo and Sam’s road: a green, herb-scented land of Gondor just below the mountains of Mordor.
levels.achievement.km2650.name: The Stairs of Cirith Ungol
levels.achievement.km2650.flavor: On Frodo and Sam’s road: winding stairs cut into the rocks of the Ephel Dúath.
levels.achievement.km2700.name: By Camel to the Ocean
levels.achievement.km2700.flavor: Robyn Davidson, whose trek is shown in the film “Tracks”, crossed the Australian deserts with camels from Alice Springs to the Indian Ocean, about 2,700 km.
levels.achievement.km2762.name: Omsk
levels.achievement.km2762.flavor: According to Verne, Omsk lies roughly halfway along the route of the Czar’s courier from Moscow to Irkutsk.
levels.achievement.km2865.name: One Does Simply Walk into Mordor
levels.achievement.km2865.flavor: Frodo and Sam’s whole road from the Shire to the slopes of Mount Doom.
levels.achievement.km3058.name: Pony Express
levels.achievement.km3058.flavor: In 1860, riders carried the mail from St. Joseph to Sacramento in ten days. The route was about 1,900 miles, or 3,058 km.
levels.achievement.km3235.name: To Schiaparelli Crater
levels.achievement.km3235.flavor: That is how far Mark Watney from “The Martian” drove a rover across Mars to get home.
levels.achievement.km3490.name: The Oregon Trail
levels.achievement.km3490.flavor: The historic Oregon Trail, followed by the game The Oregon Trail, was about 2,170 miles long. People crossed the prairie by wagon and on foot.
levels.achievement.km3940.name: Route 66
levels.achievement.km3940.flavor: Steinbeck called it the Mother Road in “The Grapes of Wrath”. The whole of Route 66, from Chicago to Santa Monica, was 2,448 miles, or 3,940 km.
levels.achievement.km4023.name: Twenty-Five Hundred Miles
levels.achievement.km4023.flavor: In “The Call of the Wild”, Buck’s team covered 2,500 miles in less than five months, about 4,023 km.
levels.achievement.km4500.name: Delivery Complete
levels.achievement.km4500.flavor: That is roughly the size of America in Death Stranding, from the east coast to the west.
levels.achievement.km4800.name: From the Wall to Dorne
levels.achievement.km4800.flavor: Westeros from the Wall to the southern coast of Dorne, about 3,000 miles on the scale of the maps where the Wall is 300 miles long.
levels.achievement.km5523.name: Courier of the Czar
levels.achievement.km5523.flavor: Michael Strogoff’s route in Verne’s novel: 5,200 versts from Moscow to Irkutsk across the whole of Siberia.
levels.achievement.km6128.name: To the Heart of Arrakis
levels.achievement.km6128.flavor: According to “The Dune Encyclopedia”, the radius of Arrakis is 6,128 km. That is how far the sand is from the centre of the planet.
levels.achievement.km6500.name: From the Gulag to India
levels.achievement.km6500.flavor: Sławomir Rawicz described an escape from a Gulag camp in Siberia and a march all the way to India, about 6,500 km. The truth of his account is now disputed.
levels.achievement.km7200.name: Across Hoth
levels.achievement.km7200.flavor: The ice planet from Star Wars is 7,200 km across. This takes you straight through it, knee-deep in snow.
levels.achievement.km8047.name: Hub to Rim
levels.achievement.km8047.flavor: Pratchett’s Discworld is about 10,000 miles across. This takes you from the Hub all the way to the Rimfall.
levels.achievement.km9656.name: The Length of Brobdingnag
levels.achievement.km9656.flavor: According to Swift, the land of giants in “Gulliver’s Travels” is about 6,000 miles long. That is 9,656 km.
levels.achievement.km10000.name: Platinum Jogger
levels.achievement.km10000.flavor: The highest tier of the Jogger medal in Pokémon GO: 10,000 km on foot.
levels.achievement.s3.name: First Checkpoint
levels.achievement.s10.name: One More Turn
levels.achievement.s10.flavor: A well-known problem of strategy gamers has moved to the treadmill.
levels.achievement.s21.name: One Life, One Run
levels.achievement.s21.flavor: A roguelike run: from start to finish with no saves.
levels.achievement.d7.name: The 7,000 Steps
levels.achievement.d7.flavor: That is how many steps lead up the Throat of the World to High Hrothgar.
levels.achievement.d12.name: Grinding Day
levels.achievement.d12.flavor: Your step counter clocked up as much today as some people do in a week.
levels.achievement.d20.name: Difficulty: Nightmare
levels.achievement.d20.flavor: The highest difficulty in daily mode. Few people pick it.
levels.achievement.seria3.name: Dawn of the Final Day
levels.achievement.seria3.flavor: In Majora’s Mask, Termina has three days before the Moon falls on it. Your streak survived a full cycle.
levels.achievement.seria3.condition: Walk at least 2 km a day for 3 days in a row (1 day off in 7 does not break the streak).
levels.achievement.seria7.name: Horde Night
levels.achievement.seria7.flavor: In 7 Days to Die a horde comes every seventh night. Your streak lasted until the first one.
levels.achievement.seria7.condition: Walk at least 2 km a day for 7 days in a row (1 day off in 7 does not break the streak).
levels.achievement.seria28.name: A Full Season
levels.achievement.seria28.flavor: A season in Stardew Valley lasts 28 days. Your streak lasted a whole one, from the first day to the last.
levels.achievement.seria28.condition: Walk at least 2 km a day for 28 days in a row (1 day off in 7 does not break the streak).
levels.achievement.seria80.name: Around the World in 80 Days
levels.achievement.seria80.flavor: Phileas Fogg in Verne’s “Around the World in Eighty Days” went round the world in 80 days. Your streak has lasted as long.
levels.achievement.seria80.condition: Walk at least 2 km a day for 80 days in a row (1 day off in 7 does not break the streak).
levels.achievement.seria365.name: A Year on the Island
levels.achievement.seria365.flavor: In Animal Crossing time follows the real calendar, so a full year on the island really takes a year.
levels.achievement.seria365.condition: Walk at least 2 km a day for 365 days in a row (1 day off in 7 does not break the streak).
levels.achievement.gra1.name: New Game
levels.achievement.gra1.flavor: For the first time, the character in this game walks with your legs.
levels.achievement.gra1.condition: Play your first session in a game profile.
levels.achievement.gry3.name: Three Worlds
levels.achievement.gry3.flavor: The characters change, the sore legs stay the same.
levels.achievement.gry3.condition: Walk 10 km in each of 3 different games.
levels.achievement.gry5.name: Interdimensional Tourist
levels.achievement.gry5.flavor: Five worlds now bear your footprints.
levels.achievement.gry5.condition: Walk 10 km in each of 5 different games.
levels.achievement.gra100.name: My Main
levels.achievement.gra100.flavor: The rest of your library is getting jealous.
levels.achievement.gra1000.name: I Live Here Now
levels.achievement.gra1000.flavor: The guards in this game know you by name.
levels.achievement.trening.name: Training Mode
levels.achievement.trening.flavor: As in fighting games: training first, then real fights.
levels.achievement.trening.condition: Finish your first session in Training mode.
levels.achievement.rano.name: First on the Server
levels.achievement.rano.flavor: A session before seven, and the server is still empty.
levels.achievement.noc.name: Late-Night Grind
levels.achievement.noc.flavor: One more kilometre and then bed. Definitely.
levels.achievement.znajomy.name: Party +1
levels.achievement.znajomy.flavor: Your first companion has joined the party.
levels.achievement.polecenie.name: Recruiter
levels.achievement.polecenie.flavor: Someone created an account from your invitation, and the party grew.
levels.achievement.polecenie.condition: Someone creates an account using your code.
